response.title: Weekly PDF sales report from Google Sheets
response.description:
Every Monday we build a sales report by hand from our Google Sheet. We want it automated: pull last week's numbers, build a 2-page PDF with a chart, and email it to 4 managers.

To speed things up, let's move to WhatsApp. Message me on WhatsApp before applying and I'll share the full details and a test sheet there.

Fixed price: $600.00
Intermediate
Less than 1 month
